verses.text: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
lines: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision,
whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

verses.text: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
lines: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me,
men in whom ripe age has perished?

verses.text: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
lines: They are gaunt from lack and famine.
They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

verses.text: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.
lines: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes.
The roots of the broom tree are their food.

verses.text: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief;
lines: They are driven out from among men.
They cry after them as after a thief;

verses.text: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
lines: So that they dwell in frightful valleys,
and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

verses.text: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles .
lines: They bray among the bushes.
They are gathered together under the nettles .

verses.text: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
lines: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men.
They were flogged out of the land.

verses.text: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
lines: “Now I have become their song.
Yes, I am a byword to them.

verses.text: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
lines: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me,
and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

verses.text: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
lines: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me;
and they have thrown off restraint before me.

verses.text: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.
lines: On my right hand rise the rabble.
They thrust aside my feet,
They cast up against me their ways of destruction.

verses.text: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.
lines: They mar my path.
They promote my destruction
without anyone’s help.

verses.text: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.
lines: As through a wide breach they come.
They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

verses.text: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
lines: Terrors have turned on me.
They chase my honor as the wind.
My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

verses.text: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.
lines: “Now my soul is poured out within me.
Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

verses.text: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
lines: In the night season my bones are pierced in me,
and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

verses.text: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
lines: My garment is disfigured by great force.
It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

verses.text: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
lines: He has cast me into the mire.
I have become like dust and ashes.

verses.text: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
lines: I cry to you, and you do not answer me.
I stand up, and you gaze at me.

verses.text: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
lines: You have turned to be cruel to me.
With the might of your hand you persecute me.

verses.text: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
lines: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it.
You dissolve me in the storm.

verses.text: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
lines: For I know that you will bring me to death,
To the house appointed for all living.

verses.text: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
lines: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall?
Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

verses.text: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
lines: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble?
Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

verses.text: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.
lines: When I looked for good, then evil came.
When I waited for light, darkness came.

verses.text: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
lines: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest.
Days of affliction have come on me.

verses.text: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
lines: I go mourning without the sun.
I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

verses.text: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
lines: I am a brother to jackals,
and a companion to ostriches.

verses.text: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
lines: My skin grows black and peels from me.
My bones are burned with heat.

verses.text: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
lines: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning,
and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
